name: Ethyl dirazepate
summary: Ethyl dirazepate is a drug which is a benzodiazepine derivative which was developed by Sanofi Winthrop. It has anxiolytic and hypnotic and possibly other characteristic benzodiazepine properties.

pharmacology.text: It has anxiolytic and hypnotic and possibly other characteristic benzodiazepine properties.

summaryZh: 地䓬乙酯（英語：Ethyl dirazepate），或譯作地卓乙酯，是一種苯二氮䓬衍生物藥物，由賽諾菲溫思羅普公司開發。它具有抗焦慮和催眠作用，可能還具有其他典型的苯二氮䓬特性。
